svg.title: LastLift architecture
svg.desc: MBTA open data is ingested into a pinned snapshot, seeded into FalkorDB, where certified max-flow finds every platform that hangs on a single lift. Thirteen read-only tools expose the graph over MCP and REST to a grounded chat agent and to operations agents that propose tickets for human approval; the website, any MCP client, the 3D walkthrough and the lastlift-ops issue tracker sit on top.

text.style: font: 760 28px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Open transit data → a certified graph → agents you can check
escalator and lift in each station
JSONL pinned by sha256, with five
exact Dinic repair when it is not
Each lift is an edge of capacity one
a lift changes → answers that read it go stale
the model never writes a query
PROVIDER CHAIN · daily call and token caps
Every id or number in an answer must appear in a tool result, or the answer is rebuilt from a template. Off-topic questions get the scope answer.
no language model in the loop
Proposals act only if the graph has not changed since they were made. Filing is off by default and, when on, accepted only from the operator's machine.
1 ingest 2 seed 3 certify every flow 4 query through fixed tools 5 agents call tools over MCP 6 act on the surfaces 7 invalidate stale answers
